title.desc: Ask in plain English. Deckhand asks for what it needs, runs the calculation, and sends back a report you can keep.

turns.html: We're worried about motions on a monohull in head seas — bad enough that crew comfort is a concern. Can you screen its seakeeping?

Happy to — a few hull particulars so I screen it the right way:
  • Length on the waterline, beam and draft?
  • Displacement, transverse GM and waterplane area?
  • Longitudinal GM for the pitch period?
  • The sea state and heading you're worried about — and the service speed?
This is a frequency-domain screen for natural periods, a heave response and a motion-comfort estimate. For full 6-DOF spectral seakeeping in irregular seas I'd flag that and pass it on.
LWL 150 m, beam 30 m, displacement 10,000 t, GM 1.0 m, waterplane area 3,000 m², longitudinal GM 150 m. Head seas at 0.8 rad/s, 8 m/s ahead, 2 h on the bridge. Particulars attached.

Got it — monohull in head seas. Basis I'll use: natural periods from the heave, pitch and roll restoring stiffness; encounter frequency for 8 m/s into 180° seas; a single-degree heave response at that frequency; and a 2-hour motion-sickness estimate from the O'Hanlon & McCauley model. Running it now…

Here's how the hull behaves:
QuantityValueNote
Heave period3.62 sshort & stiff
Pitch period6.14 s—
Roll period24.07 stender · GM 1.0 m
Heave RAO @ 0.8 rad/s1.27off resonance
Motion-sickness (2 h)8.5%✅ comfortable
Wave at 0.8 rad/s sits well clear of the 1.74 rad/s heave resonance, so heave is mild. The long 24 s roll period is the comfort watch-item — the low GM makes her tender in beam seas.

report.title: Hull Seakeeping Screen
report.inputs:
Hull particulars
LWL 150 m · Beam 30 m · Displacement 10,000 t
Transverse GM 1.0 m · Longitudinal GM 150 m
Waterplane area 3,000 m²

Environment & operation
Wave frequency 0.8 rad/s · Heading 180° (head seas)
Speed 8 m/s · Heave damping ratio 0.05
Vertical accel 0.05 g rms · Exposure 2 h
report.methodology:
1 · Heave period T = 2π√(m ÷ ρg·Awp) from mass and waterplane stiffness.
2 · Pitch period from longitudinal GM and a 0.25·L pitch gyration radius.
3 · Roll period from transverse GM and a 0.40·B roll gyration radius.
4 · Encounter frequency ωₑ = ω − (ω²÷g)·V·cos(μ) for the head-sea case.
5 · Heave response from a single-degree transfer function at the wave frequency.
6 · Motion-sickness incidence over 2 h from the O'Hanlon & McCauley model.
report.outputs:
QuantityValue
Natural heave period3.62 s
Natural pitch period6.14 s
Natural roll period24.07 s
Encounter frequency1.32 rad/s
Heave RAO @ 0.8 rad/s1.27
Significant motion2.00 m
Motion-sickness incidence (2 h)8.5%
Verdict: COMFORTABLE — motions are mild at this frequency and crew comfort clears the comfort band. Watch the 24 s roll period in beam seas; the 1.0 m GM makes her tender.
